name: air-balloon
effect: Held : Holder is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap. This effect does not apply during Gravity or Ingrain. When the holder takes damage from a move, this item is consumed.
shortEffect: Held: Grants immunity to Ground-type moves, Spikes, and Toxic Spikes. Consumed when the holder takes damage from a move.

flavorTextEntries.text: When held by a Pokémon, the Pokémon will float into the air. When the holder is attacked, this item will burst.
An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will float in the air until hit. Once hit, this item will burst.
An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will float in the air until hit. Once the holder is hit, this item will burst.
